tickets.description: When a session expires while an API call is in-flight, the response returns 401 but the refresh token flow races with the retry, causing double-refresh. Need to serialize refresh attempts.
tickets.acceptance_criteria:
* Only one refresh token request fires at a time
* In-flight requests queue behind the refresh
* Subsequent 401s during refresh use the pending token promise
* No double-refresh in network tab during expiry window
tickets.test_plan: Unit: mock concurrent 401 responses, verify single refresh. E2E: force session expiry mid-request, verify smooth recovery.
tickets.scope_boundaries: In scope: token refresh serialization. Out of scope: session duration changes.

tickets.summary: Add request ID middleware for distributed tracing
tickets.description: Add middleware that generates a UUID v4 request ID for each incoming request, attaches it to the request context, includes it in all log lines, and returns it in the X-Request-ID response header. If the incoming request already has X-Request-ID, use that (for cross-service tracing).
tickets.acceptance_criteria:
* Every response includes X-Request-ID header
* If request includes X-Request-ID, that value is used
* Otherwise a new UUID v4 is generated
* Request ID appears in all structured log lines for that request
* Works for both HTTP and WebSocket upgrade requests
tickets.test_plan: Unit: middleware generates/passes-through IDs. Integration: verify ID propagates to logs. E2E: make request, check response header matches log entries.
tickets.scope_boundaries: In scope: request ID middleware for core-api. Out of scope: cross-service propagation (separate ticket).

tickets.description: Add a timeline view to the user profile showing recent actions: logins, settings changes, data exports, and API key usage. Display last 30 days. Backend endpoint returns paginated events; frontend renders as a vertical timeline with icons per event type.
tickets.acceptance_criteria:
* Timeline shows last 30 days of user activity
* Events: login, settings change, data export, API key use
* Paginated (20 events per page, load more button)
* Each event shows: icon, description, relative timestamp
* Empty state shown for users with no activity
* API: GET /api/v1/users/:id/activity?page=1&limit=20
tickets.test_plan: Unit: event formatting, pagination logic. Integration: verify API returns correct events for test user. E2E: log in, change setting, verify both appear in timeline.
tickets.scope_boundaries: In scope: activity timeline display, backend endpoint. Out of scope: activity export, admin view of other users' activity, real-time updates.

tickets.summary: Add database migration for activity_events table
tickets.description: Create activity_events table: id (bigint PK), user_id (FK), event_type (varchar), metadata (jsonb), created_at (timestamp). Index on (user_id, created_at DESC). Partition by month if table expected to exceed 10M rows/month.
tickets.acceptance_criteria:
* Migration creates activity_events table with specified schema
* Index on (user_id, created_at DESC) exists
* Rollback migration drops table cleanly
* FK constraint on user_id references users(id)
tickets.test_plan: Run migration up/down on test DB. Verify schema with \d+ command.
tickets.scope_boundaries: In scope: table creation. Out of scope: partitioning (evaluate after 3 months of data).

tickets.summary: Add input validation to preferences API
tickets.description: The PUT /users/:id/preferences endpoint currently accepts any JSON body without validation. Need to validate channel values (enum), category existence, and boolean type for enabled field.
tickets.acceptance_criteria:
* Invalid channel values return 422 with specific error message
* Invalid category values return 422
* Non-boolean enabled values return 422
* Valid requests still succeed (regression check)
tickets.test_plan: Unit: validation logic for each field. Integration: send invalid payloads, verify 422 responses.

tickets.description: Instead of sending individual notifications for each event, allow users to opt into a daily or weekly digest email that bundles all notifications into a single message.
When the WebSocket connection drops and reconnects, the UI briefly shows a 'disconnected' banner that flickers for 200-300ms even on fast reconnects. Should only show after 2s of being disconnected.
tickets.acceptance_criteria:
* Disconnected banner only shows after 2000ms without connection
* Reconnection within 2s shows no visible UI change
* Banner dismisses immediately on successful reconnect
tickets.test_plan: E2E: simulate disconnect for <2s, verify no banner. Simulate >2s disconnect, verify banner shows and dismisses.

tickets.summary: Add pagination to admin user list
tickets.description: The admin user list currently loads all users into memory. With 50k+ users this causes timeouts. Add server-side pagination with 50 users per page.
tickets.acceptance_criteria:
* Admin user list paginates at 50 per page
* Total user count shown in header
* Page navigation (prev/next/jump-to-page)
* Current filters preserved across pages

tickets.description: Search index updates are currently processed one-at-a-time, causing a 30-minute lag between data changes and search availability. Implement batch indexing (100 documents per batch) with a 5-second flush interval.
tickets.acceptance_criteria:
* Documents indexed in batches of 100
* Maximum 5s delay from data change to search availability
* Batch failures retry individual documents
* Indexing throughput: >1000 docs/second

tickets.summary: Add rate limiting to public API endpoints
tickets.description: Public API endpoints have no rate limiting. Need to add token bucket rate limiting at 100 requests/minute per API key, with 429 responses and Retry-After header when exceeded.
tickets.acceptance_criteria:
* Rate limit of 100 req/min per API key
* 429 response with Retry-After header when exceeded
* Rate limit headers in all responses (X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Limit)
* Configurable per-endpoint overrides
